approved_public_seams: historical_accounting with hash-pinned synthetic prior usage

reason_code.privacy: No exception prose, worker/thread/turn IDs or arbitrary exception attributes are copied by this addition. Existing code/metrics/error_type behavior stays unchanged.
reason_code.behavior: Original failure re-raised. No retry. Unknown token usage continues to stop new Capture dispatch.

reported_bounds.validity: Exact four-key map, nonnegative Python ints excluding bool, cached<=input, total=input+output. Complete valid totals constrain a contradictory provided subtotal; complete legacy valid totals may supply fallback.
reported_bounds.known_subtotal: Sum only valid known reported maps. With no usable contributor, null. Do not replace absent/invalid maps with zero.
reported_bounds.coverage: reported_tokens_lower_bound_coverage_complete means all cumulative components supplied usable reported-bound metadata, NOT full native usage. Full token_accounting_complete remains separate.
reported_bounds.missing_components: Nonnegative count of missing bound components, inherited through cumulative chains. Unknown/inconsistent inherited count stays null and coverage false. It is not a count of unreported native calls.
reported_bounds.totals: Full tokens are null unless both flags are true AND both complete token maps are coherent exact integers. This conservatively downgrades malformed metadata; it does not change native budget usage/gates.
reported_bounds.partial_receipts: Unreported/partial receipt counters are not promoted into reported token bounds.

pricing.behavior: Existing API-hypothetical monetary arithmetic retained. Lower bounds are never priced. Explicit pricing completeness survives only when both sources explicitly say complete and full token maps are complete.

compatibility: Additional failed-ledger field is optional for old receipts; old rows remain readable.
Canonical historical pointer stays report/SHA, no input repair or alias is added.
Existing usage function, native budgets/profiles/caps/reuse/prompt/schema/grade and Store behavior are unchanged.
No frozen historical artifacts are edited or backfilled. The prospective helper hash will require new source pins for any future trial.
limits: Historical report data remains a pinned accounting attestation, not an independent provider audit.
Known lower bounds cannot recover usage or reason codes absent from old receipts. Missing bounds remain explicit, and actual billing remains unknown.
Coverage complete for reported bounds never means unreported native usage is known. Reported subtotal may be zero while full totals are unknown if supplied known-receipt map is valid zero.
Legacy price completeness is not inferred when its metadata is missing. No API charge or subscription cost is inferred from these counters.

Focused tests only in isolated copy; root must review/apply then run the appropriate full protocol suite against combined patches. No native calls, repo edits, services, global config, commit or Roughdraft.
